desc: Prove the characterization of legal additions: the graph remains bipartite, internal legal edges join opposite color classes, and every cross-component edge is legal.
Derive the winner criterion using terminal maximal graphs and parity of final complete-bipartite edge counts.
Determine the invariant for even `N`: the final bipartition has both sides odd exactly when an odd number of initial even-sized components have odd color-class sizes.
Implement DSU/BFS bipartite coloring in `O(N+M)` and compute the criterion safely.
Verify the implementation against all provided samples and edge cases including empty graphs, isolated vertices, complete bipartite components, and multiple components.
